title: Fault Tolerance
content:
- ### Definition
  - System properties enabling continued operation despite component failures. Encompasses redundancy, replication, consensus mechanisms, and recovery strategies that maintain service availability and data consistency when individual components fail.

- ### Semantic Classification
  - owl-class:: infrastructure:FaultTolerance
  - owl-role:: Object
  - belongs-to-domain:: [[Narrative Gold Mine]]

- ### Relationships
  - is-subclass-of:: [[SystemProperty]]
  - has-part:: [[Redundancy]], [[Replication]], [[Consensus Mechanism]], [[Health Monitoring]], [[Recovery Procedure]]
  - enables:: [[High Availability]], [[Data Consistency]], [[Continued Operation]], [[Automatic Recovery]]
  - depends-on:: [[Storage Infrastructure]], [[Network Layer]], [[Monitoring System]]

- ### Content
  Fault Tolerance ensures that narrative systems continue to serve users even when components fail. Through careful redundancy, replication, and consensus mechanisms, critical data is protected and services remain accessible. Health monitoring and automated recovery procedures minimise manual intervention and restore systems to normal operation rapidly.
